top_signals.title: Bond Traders Agonize Over AI Companies’ $70 Billion of Shadow Credit Backstops
top_signals.summary: Even before Nvidia Corp.’s splashy $500 billion financing partnership this week, investors were starting to fret over the roughly $70 billion in phantom liabilities that don’t appear on major AI companies’ balance sheets, but could materialize at the worst possible time.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin could bottom in October, altcoins are ‘basically dead,’ Swan CEO says
top_signals.summary: Klippsten said Bitcoin could bottom about a year after its previous peak and argued that crypto’s best outcome is to become part of TradFi.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
